cards.text: Then the LORD gives Moses, Israel's leader, a message for Aaron's sons, the priests. These rules are just for them. Tighten your apron strings, friend.

cards.question: The first rule for the priests is about death. True or false: A priest may defile himself for any dead person among his people.

cards.text: But there's an exception for his immediate family: his mother, father, son, daughter or brother. Your second cousin? Sorry, cuz.

cards.question: One more relative makes the priest's exception list. Who is it?
A priest is not to defile himself for those related to him by ___.

cards.text: Next up: how a priest looks. Priests must not make bald spots on their heads or shave off the edges of their beards, and friend, as a stamper with THIS mustache, I read that verse and felt SEEN.

cards.question: There's a third thing the priests must not do to their own bodies. What is it?
God says the priests must be holy to Him and not profane His name. Why?

answers.text: They present the LORD's food offerings
They were born first in their families

cards.text: Then it gets personal: who a priest can marry. He must not marry a woman defiled by prostitution or divorced by her husband, for the priest is holy to his God.

cards.question: True or false: God tells the people to regard the priest as holy, because the LORD is holy.

cards.text: If a priest's daughter defiles herself by prostituting herself, she profanes her father, and she must be burned in the fire. The text doesn't soften that one, friend, and I won't either.
Now comes the priest who is highest among his brothers, the one with the anointing oil poured on his head. He must not let his hair hang loose or tear his garments.

cards.question: Regular priests could defile themselves for close family. True or false: The highest priest may defile himself for his father or mother.
The highest priest must not leave or desecrate the sanctuary of his God. Why not?

answers.text: The anointing oil of his God is on him
He keeps watch over the gold inside
The people need him at the gate

cards.text: Then it's back to marriage, and the highest priest gets the EXTENDED edition of the list. The woman he marries must be a virgin.

cards.question: The highest priest is not to marry a ___, a divorced woman, or one defiled by prostitution.
The highest priest is to marry a virgin from his own people. Why?

answers.text: So he does not defile his offspring
So his wife can serve beside him
So his family keeps its land

cards.text: Then the LORD gives Moses another message, this one for Aaron himself. It's for the generations to come, about which of Aaron's descendants may approach to offer the food of his God.

cards.question: For the generations to come, which of Aaron's descendants may not approach to offer the food of his God?

answers.text: Any who has a physical defect
Any who was born outside Israel

cards.text: Then God lists the defects one by one, like being blind or lame, or having a broken foot or hand. A descendant of Aaron who has a defect is not to come near to offer the food of his God.

cards.question: A descendant of Aaron with a defect can't offer the food of his God. True or false: He may still eat the holy food of his God.

cards.text: He may eat the most holy food of his God as well as the holy food. Friend, I spent YEARS in the back of a junk drawer, so trust me, I notice when somebody still gets their share.

cards.question: Because he has a defect, he must not go near the ___ or approach the ___.
Why must a priest with a defect not go near the veil or approach the altar?

answers.text: To keep the altar fire burning
To give him rest from his work

cards.question: Moses passes along everything the LORD said about the priests. Who does he tell?

answers.text: Aaron and his sons and all Israel

cards.text: So the whole camp hears it, not just the priests. And friend, this teaching on holiness isn't done yet, so keep that apron on.

findings.problem: Aaron appears here for the first time with no word on who he is. Moses gets 'Israel's leader' on the same card, but Aaron is only named through 'Aaron's sons, the priests.'

rule.text: New people. The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."

findings.problem: The wrong answer 'blood' makes a statement that is true elsewhere in the passage. The question says 'A priest,' and the highest priest must not defile himself even for his father or mother (21:11), so he does not defile himself for blood relatives. A baker could argue 'blood' is right.

rule.text: Each wrong answer must be false anywhere in the passage, not just at that moment.

findings.problem: The card says 'God tells the people.' The text never names who the 'you' is in 'You are to regard him as holy' (21:8). The speech is given to Moses to tell Aaron's sons, so naming the people as the ones addressed adds something the text leaves open.

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

findings.problem: Card 4 already asked and answered that a descendant with a defect may still eat the holy food (21:22). This story card then tells 21:22 again. It only adds 'most holy food,' so it mostly recaps the answer instead of moving the passage forward.
The question begins 'Because he has a defect' without saying who 'he' is. It points back to a card the baker can no longer see.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

findings.problem: Card 8 just answered who Moses tells. The first sentence of this card, 'So the whole camp hears it, not just the priests,' repeats that answer. It also calls 'all the Israelites' 'the whole camp,' which is not what the text calls them. Since 21:24 was already asked, this card can be just the line saying the teaching isn't done.

rule.text: When the passage's last verse is asked on a choice card, the last story card can be just this line.

findings.problem: Stop 2's story cards are almost all plain retelling (cards 1, 3, 9). The only joke, on card 5, is a soft line about the drawer that doesn't land as a real laugh. The voice reads like a nice dad being pleasant, not like Papa Dorin at full comic energy.

rule.text: But he is FUNNY. Not mildly amusing. Laugh-out-loud funny, the kind a baker repeats to a friend. ... If a line reads like a nice dad being pleasant, push it further.
